sources: Gaia Catalogue of Nearby Stars (Gaia Collaboration, Smart et al. 2021), ESA/Gaia/DPAC
Hipparcos catalogue (ESA 1997) and new reduction (van Leeuwen 2007), via the ESA Gaia archive
queries: SELECT g.source_id, g.dist_50, g.ra, g.dec, g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.phot_bp_mean_mag, g.phot_rp_mean_mag, g.phot_bp_mean_flux_over_error, g.phot_rp_mean_flux_over_error, g.ruwe, g.phot_bp_rp_excess_factor, g.wd_prob, hb.original_ext_source_id AS hip FROM external.gaiaedr3_gcns_main_1 AS g LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.hipparcos2_best_neighbour AS hb ON hb.source_id = g.source_id WHERE g.dist_50 < 0.0105

SELECT h.hip, h.vmag, h.b_v, h.sptype, nr.plx, nr.e_plx, hb.source_id, gs.parallax AS gaia_plx, gs.parallax_over_error AS gaia_plx_snr FROM public.hipparcos AS h JOIN public.hipparcos_newreduction AS nr ON nr.hip = h.hip LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.hipparcos2_best_neighbour AS hb ON hb.original_ext_source_id = h.hip LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.gaia_source AS gs ON gs.source_id = hb.source_id WHERE h.vmag < 3 OR nr.plx > 95.23809523809524
spectralTypeOverrides: Capella: Hipparcos gives 'M1: comp'; the pair is G8 III + G0 III
Dubhe: Hipparcos gives 'F7V comp' (the companion); the primary is K0 III
Izar: Hipparcos gives 'A0' (the companion); the primary is K0 II–III
